explanation: The theorem says that the lintegral over Ioc 0 T of ofReal((T-s)^n/n!) equals ofReal(T^(n+1)/(n+1)!). simplexTime is a library-specific ENNReal-valued definition. I found no Mathlib lemma for this ENNReal integral of the Erlang/simplex-volume kernel. The nearest ingredients are intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left, integral_pow, integral_div and ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal. The proof combines these with a hand-built integrability argument, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of a single declaration. I grepped the library for the definition. I then grepped Mathlib for factorial in the integral, volume, simplex, Gamma and Erlang files and found nothing matching.
